name: How do I know if my interior remodel needs structural work?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my interior remodel needs structural work before I start planning finishes?
mainEntity.text: How can I tell if my interior remodel needs structural work before I start planning finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remodel likely needs structural work if it includes wall removal, larger openings, layout changes, sagging floors, cracks, uneven framing, or damage revealed by inspection. Structural needs should be identified early because they affect the design, permit path, cost, and timeline. Homeowners sometimes plan finishes first and discover later that the space cannot support the layout they want without additional framing or beams. That creates avoidable rework. The safest approach is to have the home evaluated during the planning stage so the remodel team can determine whether the changes are cosmetic, mechanical, or structural. In older Los Angeles homes, this step is especially important because prior alterations and aging framing are common.
acceptedAnswer.description: Your remodel likely needs structural work if you want to remove walls, widen openings, change room layout, correct sagging or uneven surfaces, or repair damage found during inspection. Structural issues should be identified before finishes are selected so the design and budget reflect the real scope.
